main_text.p: Templum Dei latè patetis ipsum mundum esse: eius maiestatem coarctare eum, qui ecclesias, monasteria, oratoriaque construunt.
Sacerdotales, vestes, altarium ornamenta, pallas, corporalia, calices, patenas, vasaque huiusmodi nil habere momenti.
Sacerdotem, quocunque loco, aut tempore, sacrum Christi corpus conficere posse, poenitentibusque ministrare.
Suffragia sanctorum in coelis frustra impetrari, quae iuvari nil poterint.
In canonicis horis cantandis, dicendisque, frustra tempus teri.
Nulla die ab opere cessandum, nisi quae dominica appellatur.
main_text.head: Celebritates, divinorum reiciedas.

page.notes: Printed text is set in a larger than usual size with long s rendered as s; the header reads "SIASTICAE, LIB. I." with the letters partly obscured at the start. The last two lines are set in a different, slanted arrangement and may be a catchword-like fragment; "Ieiunijs" is uncertain. Some words near the paper edge are faint.
